Only discrepancy is expected: Crossref/UTP list the journal under its current name 'Cartographica' (renamed 1980, MARC 785 'Cartographica (1980)'); in 1973 it was printed as 'The Canadian Cartographer' (HathiTrust MARC 245, v. 5-16 1968-1979), which is what the entry has, and the house keeps a printed leading 'The' (392 journal fields, e.g. 'The Journal of Neuroscience'). An automated Crossref comparator will flag journal 'Cartographica' vs 'The Canadian Cartographer' -- that is a rename, not an error.
